cp_expand_freight.evidence_check: For a purchased leg, record the delivered service demand in its contracted native unit. Derive mass-distance only for that basis, from measured packed payload or loaded gross minus matched noncargo tare, times distance and evidenced repetitions (EACH only). For own operation use actual foreground quantities including necessary empty legs. Link fuel and electricity inputs, direct elementary releases, and asset duties to their responsible process and individual units. For mixed operation assign each leg or separately evidenced stage once. Verify weighings, route, dispatch, meter and overlapping coverage by leg.
